thesis: The episode introduces Chris Burniske, a former traditional analyst and current partner at Placeholder, who has developed new frameworks for valuing crypto assets by marrying techniques from several different asset classes. The conversation begins with a deep dive into the equation of exchange as a starting point for understanding the utility value of crypto assets.
